nodes.title: What billing documents must Vyakti issue to enterprise buyers (GST tax invoice with GSTIN and place of supply, payment receipts, credit notes, PO numbers), and from when?
nodes.closes_when: the owner sets the customer price (decision.2026-10-21.pricing-deferred) and a CA confirms GST timing on wallet top-ups, CGST+SGST vs IGST from GSTIN and place of supply, and the e-invoicing threshold; then invoice.get issues a numbered tax invoice beside the usage statement
nodes.detail: Walkthrough R9: Billing shows a usage statement only. Blueprint economics-platform 2.4 proposes a monthly GST invoice with PO number, NEFT/RTGS to a per-tenant virtual account, and Form 16A TDS credits. Nothing can be invoiced while no price is set; receipts for top-ups can come first because a top-up has an amount.

nodes.title: What do practice calls (browser tests, ring-my-phone tests) draw on when the wallet is ₹0?
nodes.closes_when: the owner picks: wallet, a free daily test allowance, or nothing; then Today and Billing say it in one line
nodes.detail: Walkthrough R12: Today shows 'Spend today ₹0.09' while the wallet is ₹0 and Empty.
nodes.recommendation: A free daily test allowance that never touches the wallet, as the blueprint proposes (economics-platform 2.1 and 2.6: browser tests inside a ₹200/day test budget are not billed). Practice calls are metered as Vyakti's own cost, capped by the allowance per workspace per IST day. Today and Billing read 'Practice calls today: ₹0.09 of your free ₹200, not charged to your wallet'. Past the allowance, practice calls stop with 'Add money to keep testing today' rather than charging an empty wallet. Reason: a buyer with ₹0 must still be able to hear the agent before paying, which is the self-serve promise, and the cost is small (about ₹1.4-2 a minute of provider cost). The ₹200 figure is the blueprint's and is the owner's to confirm.

events.what: Money R4: money.parts gives every buildable part a ₹-per-minute figure (USD list price as basis); stack.list shows it as the part's price. R5: the 'VP' strings in the walkthrough screenshots match pre-d69f3ff code verbatim (the walk's server predated that commit); current code and stored cost-card rows say Vyakti; a guard test now covers every money read tool and the stored rows. R9 and R12 logged as open questions.
